data.one_liner: Core token refresh library for managing authentication token lifecycles.
data.what_it_does: Exposes core components common to various token refresh implementations such as REST or GraphQL. Provides token lifecycle management, single-flight refresh coordination, and stream-based authentication state tracking.
use_when: You are building a custom HTTP client integration that requires token refresh logic.
You need to coordinate concurrent refresh attempts to share a single in-flight operation.
avoid_when: You are using standard clients like Dio or the http package (use fresh_dio or fresh_http integration packages instead).
You do not need token refresh functionality.
strengths: Single-flight refresh coordination prevents duplicate concurrent refresh requests.
Extensible token base class and custom storage support.
weaknesses: Most users must rely on separate integration packages for standard clients.
Requires writing custom boilerplate if building a non-standard integration.
